item: PF07 built: the calendar, law and hazard-feed opt-outs are real settings, reachable from the API and the Settings page
key_paths: src/scheduler/settings.py; src/scheduler/runner.py; src/api/scheduler.py; src/static/net-hosts.js; src/static/index.html; src/static/app-sources.js; docs/SECURITY.md; tests/test_security_endpoint_enumeration.py
summary: The maintainer's answer PF07 = a. auto_import_calendars and auto_track_law become SchedulerSettings fields and auto_track_signals is declared on the request model, all default on; the runner reads them directly, three checkboxes join Settings > Advanced > Collection, and the noOptOut/settingUnreachable disclosures come off law, calendars and hazards (Markets keeps noOptOut). No migration; six strings x12.
